parameters.name: identityType
parameters.description: The external identity type to use for an exact user lookup. Use `social` for a social connector identity or `sso` for an enterprise SSO identity. Must be provided together with `identityProvider` and `identityId`. External identity filters are combined with other user filters using AND logic.

parameters.name: identityProvider
parameters.description: The connector target for a social identity (for example, `dingtalk`), or the issuer for an enterprise SSO identity. Must be provided together with `identityType` and `identityId`.

parameters.name: identityId
parameters.description: The user identifier issued by the external identity provider, such as a DingTalk OpenID. Must be provided together with `identityType` and `identityProvider`.

parameters.name: customData
parameters.description: A repeatable filter for exact user lookup by custom data. Each value must be a URL-encoded JSON object, for example `customData=%7B%22qq%22%3A114514%7D` for `{"qq":114514}`. Matching uses PostgreSQL JSONB containment (`users.custom_data @> value::jsonb`) with strict JSON types: the number `114514` does not match the string `"114514"`, strings are case-sensitive without phone/date normalization, and `null` only matches an explicit JSON `null`, not a missing key. Nested objects are matched recursively, and arrays are matched by element regardless of order or duplicates. All keys within one object are combined with AND, repeated `customData` parameters are combined with OR, and the whole custom data condition is combined with `search`, identity, `excludeRoleId`, and `excludeOrganizationId` filters using AND. Empty objects and empty arrays are rejected with 400, and at most 20 `customData` values are allowed per request. The `mode`, `joint`, and `isCaseSensitive` parameters do not apply to `customData`, and nested syntax such as `customData.qq` or `mode.customData` is not supported.

nested.summary: Match nested object and array values

200.description: An array of users that match the given criteria.

cimdClientId.description: The identifier of the CIMD (client ID metadata document) client from the user's first consent. `null` unless the user's first consent was granted to a CIMD client. Mutually exclusive with `applicationId`.

get.description:
Get users with filters and pagination.

Logto provides a very flexible way to query users. You can filter users by almost any fields with multiple modes. To learn more about the query syntax, please refer to [Advanced user search](https://docs.logto.io/docs/recipes/manage-users/advanced-user-search/).
